I've built an interactive dependency map for the Prime Number Theorem development in Lean:

https://arkitect-lab.k-inside.com/proofmaps/p/prime-number-theorem?top=50&view=graph_model

Double-click on any theorem or lemma to explore its dependencies and navigate through the proof.

We've also experimented with distinguishing important from less important parts of the graph using small LLMs (Mistron 120-12A and Limit 1B), combined with graph analysis techniques.

I'd be very interested in feedback, especially from people familiar with this development.
